name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site reverse proxy and web server with SSL paths, site-specific virtual hosts, security hardening, fail2ban, firewall and SSH settings, and sample static content.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, runtime and logging directories, configuration management, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI application from Git, creates its virtual environment and dependencies, initializes PostgreSQL and application credentials, and runs Uvicorn under systemd.
